privacy.neroevents.export.cooldown: You can ask for another export in %1$s s.
privacy.neroevents.export.done: Your NeroEvents data was written to %1$s in the world folder. Ask the server operator for the file. It is deleted after 7 days.

privacy.neroevents.export.failed: The export could not be written. The server log has the reason.
privacy.neroevents.optin.already: You had not opted out. Nothing changed.
privacy.neroevents.optin.done: NeroEvents will store your reward history again (kept %1$s days). Rows written while you were opted out stay anonymous.
privacy.neroevents.optout.already: You have already opted out. Nothing changed.
privacy.neroevents.optout.done: From now on NeroEvents stores no reward history under your player id. You are still paid: credits go to your account, items and XP go to a temporary reward crate that is cleared when the server restarts — claim them with /neroevents claim before then. Because nothing is stored, a server restart during an event could pay you twice or not at all for that event. Earlier rows keep your id until they expire (at most %1$s days) or you ask for erasure with /neroland data eraseme. Undo with /neroevents privacy optin.
privacy.neroevents.optout.done.solo: From now on NeroEvents stores no reward history under your player id. You are still paid: credits go to your account, items and XP go to a temporary reward crate that is cleared when you leave the world — claim them with /neroevents claim before then. Because nothing is stored, leaving the world during an event could pay you twice or not at all for that event. Earlier rows keep your id until they expire (at most %1$s days) or you ask for erasure with /neroland data eraseme. Undo with /neroevents privacy optin.
privacy.neroevents.status.disabled: This server keeps no reward history (rewardLedgerEnabled=false).
privacy.neroevents.status.disabled.solo: This world keeps no reward history (rewardLedgerEnabled=false).
privacy.neroevents.status.in: Reward history: stored under your id for %1$s days; %2$s row(s) now; %3$s reward stack(s) waiting in your crate (kept %4$s days). Opt out: /neroevents privacy optout.
privacy.neroevents.status.out: Reward history: opted out — new rows are anonymous and new rewards go to a temporary crate, lost on restart (%1$s stack(s) waiting in total). Opt back in: /neroevents privacy optin.
